first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's August 2026 Transaction unique identifier ↔ INSPIRE ID lookup distribution is an official linkage source, but its CSV payload rows cannot be retrieved through the current transport and the lookup dataset itself does not carry parcel geometry. Local OpenCode must retrieve a concrete lookup row relevant to the target building/transaction, then retrieve and spatially bind the corresponding INSPIRE polygon; after that bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the parcel bbox.
exact_blocker: The official HM Land Registry lookup page confirms a current August 2026 CSV distribution containing Transaction unique identifier and INSPIRE ID fields, released under OGL v3.0 and updated 29 September 2026. The CSV endpoint is public/no-login but returns an unsupported text/csv payload through the current transport, so no concrete lookup row, INSPIRE ID, canonical_parcel_id, or parcel geometry is asserted. Moreover the lookup table links identifiers but does not itself supply geometry. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
